name: fingerprint
useCase: Identify fingerprint sign-in or fingerprint enrollment beside its label.
misuse: Do not use the fingerprint as proof of identity or successful authentication without an explicit status label.

16.reason: Wider nested arches keep all three ridges visibly separate; a break on the left and a curved center tail retain the fingerprint shape within the 12 × 12 drawing frame.

24.reason: The larger arches use longer curves and wider spacing around the center ridge within the 18 × 18 drawing frame.
